name: PEMS04: Caltrans District 4 Spatial-Temporal Highway Traffic Flow
description: PEMS04 is a spatial-temporal traffic flow dataset sourced from the Caltrans Performance Measurement System (PeMS) for District 4 (San Francisco Bay Area). Introduced in ASTGCN (AAAI 2019), it compiles traffic measurements from 307 loop detectors recorded at 5-minute intervals from January 1 to February 28, 2018 (16,992 timestamps), featuring 3 traffic attributes: flow, occupancy, and speed.
